title: Encoding a Word by a Valid Split
statement: For natural numbers $C,c$ and a Boolean word $w$, if the split-solving procedure for $C,c$, and the length of $w$ returns a split position $i$, define the result to be the pair encoding of the prefix of $w$ of length $i$ and the suffix after that prefix. If no split position is returned, define the result to be the empty word.
caveat: The split-solving procedure and pair encoding are not defined in the supplied payload.
